The Vermont Brewers Festival turns 33 this year, and we have something for everyone! Join us on the Burlington Waterfront on July 17-18.

New this year: a first-ever VIP session (Friday night, very limited seats, early access + exclusive pours), Designated Driver tickets so your whole crew can come, and three tasting sessions featuring 200+ beers, local food, music, and views of Lake Champlain that never get old.

GA tickets start at $60. VIP is $115. DD tickets are $22. All on sale May 1st at 11 am.

33 years of brewers, for the brewers, for all of us. See you on the waterfront.

www.vtbrewfest.com
